test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct Speech,

She said that she was going to the market.

options.text: She said, "I have gone to the market."
She said, "I am going to the market.
She said, "I will go to the market."
She said, "I was going to the market."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she was going to the market.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"She was going to the market" becomes "I am going to the market"**
 
 
• The third-person pronoun "she" is converted to the first-person pronoun "I" to match the speaker's point of view in direct speech.
 
• The past continuous tense "was going" is converted to the present continuous tense "am going" to reflect the direct speech format.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "She said that"
 
• Converted to: "She said," to introduce the direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in double quotation marks.
 
• The first word of the quoted speech starts with a capital letter.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She said, ‘I am going to the market.’"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She said, ‘I have gone to the market.’"

 
 
• The verb tense "have gone" changes the meaning to the present perfect, which does not match the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "She said, ‘I will go to the market.’"
 
 
• The future tense "will go" changes the timing implied in the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She said, ‘I was going to the market.’"
 
 
• While the tense matches, it does not align with the usual conversion of indirect to direct speech where the tense reflects the speaker's present perspective.
